newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela bolivar gains slightly on Cenbank sales.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela bolivar gains slightly on Cenbank sales.

text.p: The Venezuelan bolivar closed slightly stronger at 471.50/472.50 per dollar on Wednesday compared to 471.75/472.75 per dollar Tuesday as the Central Bank entered the market to satisfy heavy dollar demand, traders said.
"The market was fairly busy and at first it (the exchange rate) rose. The Central Bank intervened strongly after the morning to meet those who were short," one trader said.
Traders said they saw another busy day of trading on Thursday as many clients were still short on dollars.
